statement: Ordinary Quest reports and overview boards are on-demand local projections rather than durable workflow evidence; audit, next, and handoff depend only on declarations, event logs, exact change artifacts, and verifier receipts, while non-regenerable report evidence remains retained and migration is content-auditable.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Only immediate Markdown reports with matching Quest declarations and event logs are removable projections; nested and otherwise unique report evidence must retain exact path, bytes, and hash.
The migration must record the base commit and exact hashes of removed and retained paths before deleting tracked projections, so every removed byte remains recoverable from Git.
Report and overview generators remain available on demand, but their freshness and presence never gate audit, next, checkpoint, or terminal handoff.
